editorial.blurb: Los Chapines Tortillería serves authentic Guatemalan and Mexican food that keeps customers returning for the fresh, flavorful dishes and genuine warmth.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early for breakfast around 7:30 AM when the full menu is available—the shuco chapines and dobladas de queso are standouts, and don't miss grabbing a bottle of Guatemalan hot sauce on your way out.

topDishes.note: hearty, satisfying enough to be a meal on its own
